2 · Field Mapping

Columns are auto-detected first. Every field remains editable from the dropdown if the detected mapping is missing or incorrect.

Order rule: full Clients Order Number is kept for grouping; the first clean order number is used for display.
FieldInput ColumnDetected ValueStatus

3 · Currency Conversion (FX) Settings

Fixed business rule: source currency is USD, target currency is AUD, and the historical FX rate is fetched automatically from Frankfurter using the Order Time date. If that date has no published rate, the previous available rate is used and recorded.

USD → AUD · Rate by Order Time date · Frankfurter historical rate

5 · Summary

Daily COGS

One row per calendar date found in the file — dates are never combined into a single week total.

Order Details

Order-level aggregation is grouped by the full Clients Order Number (internal unique key). The 6-digit Order ID from MID(D2,2,6) is display/reference only. Supplier Total cost is counted once per order as Shipping Cost.

Review Needed 0

Rows the automation could not process with full confidence.

Reconciliation

Internal consistency (Detail → Order → Daily)
Source checks (only when the supplier field is actually available)

Xero Journal Preview

Xero Settings Defaults

Default journal mapping. Processing Cost is calculated as daily order count × the per-order fee below (client default A$0.63), kept to the cent. GST % is used only for the GST / COGS ex-GST columns. Use Edit only if the current organisation requires different Xero values.
These defaults are used in the Xero CSV. You can edit or clear them if needed; downloads are never blocked.

Downloads

Export is always allowed. Any incomplete rows, orders, dates, or journals remain clearly marked Review Needed.

Numeric values are exported as real numbers; dates are exported as MM/DD text per the SOP.
